"""Run the native source-size rectangle packing workflow."""

from pathlib import Path

from .plots import save_costs, save_packing, save_trace
from .workflow import SHOTS, run_workflow

FOLDER = Path("artifacts/development/rectangle-packing")


def main() -> None:
    result = run_workflow()
    print(
        "Placement variables and Ising terms:",
        len(result.model.placements),
        len(result.model.terms),
    )
    print(
        "Actual objective queries and shots:",
        len(result.evaluations),
        len(result.evaluations) * SHOTS,
    )
    print("Final draws:", sum(count for _, count in result.sampled))
    print("Best sampled mean:", result.selected.mean_cost)
    print("Observed word and cost:", result.word, float(result.model.cost[result.word]))
    print("Observed placements:", result.placements)
    print("Independent minimum cost:", result.exact_cost)
    print("Budget stop and convergence:", result.budget_reached, result.converged)
    print("Native resources:", result.program.report["resources"])
    print(save_trace(result, FOLDER / "trace.png"))
    print(save_costs(result, FOLDER / "costs.png"))
    print(save_packing(result, FOLDER / "packing.png"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run the original-size finite-sample QAOA optimization and final packing draw."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.algorithms import CobylaOptimizer

from .model import PackingModel, Placement, make_model, unpack
from .quantum import LAYERS, probabilities, program_builder

MAX_QUERIES = 60
SHOTS = 10000


class _QueryBudgetError(Exception):
    """Stop before a query would exceed the stated evaluation budget."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Evaluation:
    """The sampled mean and the actual angles used to obtain it."""

    mean_cost: float
    angles: tuple[float, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PackingRun:
    """Actual sampled result and the separate classical optimum."""

    model: PackingModel
    evaluations: tuple[Evaluation, ...]
    selected: Evaluation
    sampled: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]
    word: int
    placements: tuple[Placement, ...]
    exact_cost: float
    converged: bool
    budget_reached: bool
    program: synth.Program


def initial_angles(model: PackingModel) -> tuple[float, ...]:
    """Scale the ten-layer ramp by the largest half of nonconstant term magnitudes."""
    weights = sorted(abs(coefficient) for _, coefficient in model.terms[1:])
    large = weights[len(weights) // 2 :]
    step = len(large) / (2 * math.fsum(large))
    last = LAYERS - 1
    return tuple(
        value
        for layer in range(LAYERS)
        for value in (step * layer / last, step * (last - layer) / last)
    )


def run_workflow() -> PackingRun:
    """Minimize the actual sampled mean and select only from the final observed words."""
    model = make_model()
    build = program_builder(model)
    evaluations: list[Evaluation] = []
    rng = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)

    def objective(angles: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        if len(evaluations) >= MAX_QUERIES:
            raise _QueryBudgetError
        binding = tuple(map(float, angles))
        draw = torch.multinomial(
            probabilities(build(binding)), SHOTS, replacement=True, generator=rng
        )
        mean = model.cost[draw].mean()
        evaluations.append(Evaluation(float(mean), binding))
        return mean

    budget_reached = False
    try:
        optimized = CobylaOptimizer(
            maxiter=MAX_QUERIES, rhobeg=1.0, rhoend=1e-8
        ).minimize(objective, torch.tensor(initial_angles(model), dtype=torch.float64))
        converged = optimized.converged
    except _QueryBudgetError:
        budget_reached = True
        converged = False
    chosen = min(evaluations, key=lambda row: row.mean_cost)
    program = build(chosen.angles)
    draw = torch.multinomial(
        probabilities(program),
        SHOTS,
        replacement=True,
        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(7),
    )
    counts = torch.bincount(draw, minlength=model.cost.numel())
    sampled = tuple(
        (int(word), int(counts[word])) for word in counts.nonzero().flatten()
    )
    word, _ = min(sampled, key=lambda row: (float(model.cost[row[0]]), -row[1], row[0]))
    return PackingRun(
        model,
        tuple(evaluations),
        chosen,
        sampled,
        word,
        unpack(model, word),
        float(model.cost.min()),
        converged,
        budget_reached,
        program,
    )

"""Plot actual optimization samples and the selected packing geometry."""

from collections import defaultdict
from importlib import import_module
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .model import HEIGHT, RECTANGLES, WIDTH
from .workflow import SHOTS, PackingRun


def _pyplot() -> Any:
    return import_module("matplotlib.pyplot")


def _save(pyplot: Any, figure: Any, path: Path) -> Path:
    figure.tight_layout()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure.savefig(path, dpi=100)
    pyplot.close(figure)
    return path


def save_trace(result: PackingRun, path: Path) -> Path:
    pyplot = _pyplot()
    figure, axis = pyplot.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
    axis.plot(
        range(1, len(result.evaluations) + 1),
        [record.mean_cost for record in result.evaluations],
    )
    axis.set(
        xlabel="Actual objective query",
        ylabel="Sampled mean penalized cost",
        title="QAOA rectangle packing",
    )
    return _save(pyplot, figure, path)


def save_costs(result: PackingRun, path: Path) -> Path:
    pyplot = _pyplot()
    figure, axis = pyplot.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
    frequencies: dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for word, count in result.sampled:
        frequencies[int(result.model.cost[word])] += count
    axis.hist(
        list(frequencies),
        weights=[count / SHOTS for count in frequencies.values()],
        bins=30,
    )
    axis.set(
        xlabel="Penalized cost",
        ylabel="Sampled probability",
        title="Final sampled costs",
    )
    return _save(pyplot, figure, path)


def save_packing(result: PackingRun, path: Path) -> Path:
    pyplot = _pyplot()
    figure, axis = pyplot.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.7))
    colors = ("#286c94", "#389a88", "#d17043")
    for i, x, y in result.placements:
        width, height = RECTANGLES[i]
        axis.add_patch(
            pyplot.Rectangle(
                (x, y), width, height, edgecolor="black", facecolor=colors[i], alpha=0.7
            )
        )
        axis.text(
            x + width / 2,
            y + height / 2,
            f"R{i}",
            color="white",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
        )
    axis.set(
        xlim=(0, WIDTH),
        ylim=(HEIGHT, 0),
        xticks=list(range(WIDTH + 1)),
        yticks=list(range(HEIGHT + 1)),
        title=f"Observed packing, cost {float(result.model.cost[result.word]):g}",
        xlabel="x grid site",
        ylabel="y grid site",
    )
    axis.set_aspect("equal")
    axis.grid(alpha=0.35)
    return _save(pyplot, figure, path)
